messages.text:
Hello,

I can't recall how many times I've contacted you about the missing European
power cables for my Nexus Devices.

I really urge you to send the European power cables.

For months, I haven't been able to use the devices. I really think that
your "after-sales" needs some refinement.

Roy K.
(address hidden)
(address hidden)
The Netherlands
Handed to the team · I cannot order or ship a loose power cord with my tools; a person has to buy and

Hello Roy,

You are right to be annoyed, and I am sorry. Your Nexus L1 and S1 arrived in June and July with the wrong cord, you have chased us since, and nothing was sent. That is our failure, not yours.

Here is where it stands now. Both units need a standard Schuko to C13 cord, and I have put the request for two of them in front of a colleague on the team this afternoon, with your current address in (address hidden) rather than the (address hidden) address on the order. They are picking it up today and will confirm to you by email, with tracking, once the cords are on their way. There is nothing to pay and nothing to send back.

If anything else on the order needs sorting, just reply here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Any Progress???

Sent from my iPhone

Hello Roy,

Nothing has gone out yet, and I am not going to dress that up. Your request for the two Schuko cords is with the team, and I can see no shipment has been created against your order so far today.

They are offline for the evening and pick this up first thing tomorrow at 10am Eastern. You do not need to do anything or write again. You will get an email from us confirming the cords and the tracking as soon as they are sent, to this address.

I am sorry you have had to ask again. The request is sitting at the top of their list with your (address hidden) address on it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

with all respect this seem an automatic AI reply, isn't it...

is this how you deal with your customers?
Handed to the team · Customer asked whether he is talking to a bot and wants a human handling the cab

Hello Roy,

Fair question, and a straight answer: I am the automated first line of our support team, and a person takes over when something needs them. That is the case here, so I have put your thread in front of a colleague by name rather than leaving it in a queue.

No, this is not how we should be dealing with you. Two cords should have gone out in July, and three months of asking is not something I can defend.

A person picks this up tomorrow morning at 10am Eastern. They will reply here themselves, and you will get the confirmation and tracking for the two Schuko cords to (address hidden) in (address hidden). You do not need to write again for that to happen.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

With all respect, nothing is received.please share me the track and trace link.

Best regards Roy decline

Sent from my iPhone
Handed to the team · No tracking link exists on our side for the Amazon.nl cable order, and nothing o

Hello Roy,

I am sorry, and I am going to be straight with you rather than send you a link I cannot stand behind. The cords went out as an Amazon.nl order, reference ····, and that kind of order does not give us a carrier track and trace link on our side. I have no tracking to copy to you, and since you have not received anything, the delivery itself needs checking with Amazon directly.

A colleague picks that up tomorrow morning at 10am Eastern. They will check the Amazon order, send you whatever proof of delivery or tracking exists, and if it has not actually gone out, they will reorder the two cords with a carrier that does give you a trackable number. You will get that reply here, in this thread.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
